patterns.note: Sections frequently use an asymmetrical layout, pairing large, full-bleed product photography with text blocks that are offset to one side, creating dynamic visual balance.
A dramatic contrast in type scale is used, featuring extremely oversized, bold display headings that dominate sections, juxtaposed with smaller, refined body text.

The site employs a high-contrast, limited color palette dominated by a vibrant, almost monochromatic red, paired with black/dark grey and white, with a single bright orange accent for calls to action.

The hero product image dynamically scales down and translates upwards as the user scrolls, creating a 'sticky' parallax effect that reveals subsequent content sections with a subtle fade-in or slide-up.
Each major content section is introduced by a large, evocative heading and often features full-bleed product imagery or a solid background color (red or white) to clearly delineate content blocks.

technique_notes: Full-bleed, high-resolution product photography is a primary visual element, often serving as dynamic backgrounds or focal points within sections.

Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate a sophisticated scroll-based animation system where the hero product image scales and translates upwards, while new content sections fade or slide into view as they enter the viewport.
Headings are rendered in an extremely large, bold sans-serif font, creating strong visual anchors and a sense of editorial grandeur against more understated body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold display headings (up to ~8x body text) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most UI elements and image frames featuring crisp, angular corners, contrasting with the organic curves of the product itself.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous padding and margins around content blocks, especially in the hero and between major sections, contributing to an uncluttered, premium feel.

standout: The site's bold, almost monochromatic red aesthetic, combined with the dramatic scale of its typography and the dynamic, product-focused scroll animation, makes it feel less like a typical e-commerce page and more like an editorial feature or art piece. The hero product animation, where the device scales and moves up the screen, is particularly distinctive and engaging.
